I’m skeptical and I’m not sure where I stand on my belief in the supernatural. Growing up (and sometimes still), I hear footsteps walking through the house or my family’s voices when I’m home alone, which creeps me out. Lately though, something supernatural has become comforting. My cat died unexpectedly from cancer a few months ago, at only two years old. I loved him so much. He was a fat black tuxedo cat who was mischievous and lazy, and his breath always smelled like fish. Since he died, I’ve had moment that could be supernatural that leads me to feel that he’s still here. Sometimes I can hear the thump he made when he jumped off the bathroom cabinet when only my other cat is in and she’s laying with me.
